# External Tools & Versions {#sec-appendix-tools}

The external command-line tools PhyloTrace drives, all installed in the single
`PhyloTrace` Conda environment and pinned in `environment.yml` (@sec-arch-conda,
@sec-install). Versions are pinned deliberately: the parsing logic is written
against these exact outputs.

## Pinned toolchain

| Tool | Version | Role | Chapter |
|---|---|---|---|
| **pyMLST** | 2.2.2 (pip, non-editable) | cgMLST (`wgMLST`) + classical (`claMLST`) typing; scheme download | @sec-tech-typing, @sec-tech-schemes |
| **BLAT** | 35 | Sequence alignment behind pyMLST typing | @sec-tech-typing |
| **MAFFT** | 7.525 | Multiple sequence alignment where needed | @sec-tech-typing |
| **abritamr** | 1.0.19 | Curation wrapper around AMRFinderPlus | @sec-tech-amr |
| **NCBI AMRFinderPlus** | 3.12.8 | AMR / virulence / stress gene detection (`--plus`) | @sec-tech-amr |
| *(transitive)* BLAST, HMMER | via abritamr/AMRFinderPlus | Search backends | @sec-tech-amr |
| Python | 3.12 | Interpreter for the above | @sec-install |

```{.yaml filename="environment.yml"}
name: PhyloTrace
channels: [conda-forge, bioconda]
dependencies:
  - python=3.12
  - blat=35
  - mafft=7.525
  - abritamr=1.0.19
  - ncbi-amrfinderplus=3.12.8
  - pip
  - pip:
      - pymlst==2.2.2
```

## How they are invoked

Every call goes through `conda run -n PhyloTrace …`, orchestrated by
`app/logic/pymlst.R` and the shell script `app/logic/loop-pymlst.sh` (@sec-tech-typing).
The base `conda` is resolved from `CONDA_EXE` in preference to any env-local
`conda` on `PATH` (@sec-arch-conda). Tool versions are parsed from the run logs
and stored per isolate in `typing_provenance` (@sec-tech-typing-provenance), so any
call can be traced to the exact tool and reference-database version that produced
it.

## External data services

Beyond the local toolchain, PhyloTrace makes a small number of outbound calls:

| Service | Used for | Chapter |
|---|---|---|
| cgMLST.org | cgMLST scheme download | @sec-tech-schemes |
| PubMLST / Institut Pasteur REST | classical-MLST scheme resolution | @sec-tech-typing |
| OpenStreetMap / Nominatim | geocoding place names for the map | @sec-tech-engines-map |
| Natural Earth (`rnaturalearth`) | country polygons for the choropleth | @sec-tech-engines-map |

No isolate data is sent to any of these; the calls request public reference data
or resolve a place name (@sec-install).
